Package org.cyclops.colossalchests2.storage

Class ChestStorage

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.colossalchests2.storage.ChestStorage
All Implemented Interfaces:
IChestContents
public class ChestStorage extends Object implements IChestContents
Deep-slot storage engine: a fixed number of slots, each holding one item type with a long count. Capacity is determined by a CapacityProfile. Slots holding more than their capacity are extract-only. This ensures that lowering capacity never deletes items.

    • insertAutomated

      public long insertAutomated(net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack type, long amount, boolean simulate)
      Insert from automation. A type held by a voiding slot only fills the slots that already hold it, and what does not fit is destroyed, so voided overflow never takes new slots. Player inserts never void.
      Parameters:
      type - The item type, its count is ignored.
      amount - The amount to insert.
      simulate - If the storage must not change.
      Returns:
      The amount accepted, including what is destroyed.

    • insertAutomated

      public long insertAutomated(net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack type, long amount, boolean simulate, boolean voidFull)
      insertAutomated(ItemStack, long, boolean), optionally voiding like every slot is voiding.
      Parameters:
      type - The item type, its count is ignored.
      amount - The amount to insert.
      simulate - If the storage must not change.
      voidFull - If any held type is voided, as through a Void wall.
      Returns:
      The amount accepted, including what is destroyed.

    • insertAutomated

      public long insertAutomated(int slot, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack type, long amount, boolean simulate)
      Insert from automation into a specific slot. What does not fit is destroyed if the slot is voiding for the type and no other slot holding the type has room, so automation walking the slots does not void what fits elsewhere.
      Parameters:
      slot - A slot index.
      type - The item type, its count is ignored.
      amount - The amount to insert.
      simulate - If the storage must not change.
      Returns:
      The amount accepted, including what is destroyed.
